news.headline: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 17% YoY to Rs 3,622 crore; revenue up 24%
news.summary: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Adani Ports reported a 17% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 3,622 crore, while revenue grew 24% to Rs 11,340 crore. The company raised its FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance by Rs 1,000 crore each and increased its capex guidance by Rs 3,000 crore, citing strong first-half performance.

news.headline: Isha Ambani says Jio IPO marks a promise, renews Dhirubhai Ambani’s trust with investors
news.summary: Isha Ambani described Jio Platforms’ stock market debut as a promise to honour the trust of investors and customers, nearly five decades after Dhirubhai Ambani took Reliance Industries public. Jio’s Rs 30,200-crore IPO attracted over Rs 7 lakh crore in demand, with the stock listing at a 21.3% premium.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Q3 profit rises 14% to beat estimates; announces €1.3 billion buyback
news.summary: BNP Paribas reported a 14% year-on-year rise in third-quarter net income to €3.46 billion, beating analyst estimates as record equity trading revenue boosted investment banking. The French lender also announced a €1.3 billion share buyback.

news.headline: Infosys, TechM, TCS, other IT stocks plunge up to 5%, extend losses as global AI trade rebounds. What lies ahead?
news.summary: Indian IT stocks fell sharply on Wednsday as renewed optimism around the global AI trade weighed on sentiment. Strong earnings from SK Hynix and Anthropic’s IPO filing fuelled gains in AI-linked stocks globally. However, concerns over an AI bubble persist, with analysts highlighting a potential advantage for Indian IT services firms.

news.headline: Global Market: Japan bond yields rise as investors eye BOJ policy meeting
news.summary: Japanese government bond yields rise as an AI-led equity rebound weakens safe-haven demand. Investors await the BOJ’s policy decision and guidance on future rate hikes amid persistent inflation, fiscal uncertainty and concerns over government borrowing.

news.headline: Jio Platforms listing at BSE: 'Will create value for decades to come', says Akash Ambani
Jio after listing: 5 factors that could drive big returns for long-term investors
news.summary: Jio Platforms recently debuted on the stock market with a strong initial premium over its IPO price. The company is well-positioned for growth due to its largest subscriber base and potential market expansion. Increased revenue can also result from higher average revenue per user and upcoming tariff hikes. Additionally, Jio's ventures into home broadband, AI, and cloud services present new revenue opportunities.

news.headline: EAAA India Alternatives IPO Day 3: Check GMP, subscription status and key details
news.summary: EAAA India Alternatives’ Rs 1,200-crore IPO entered its final subscription day on October 28, 2026, with 33% subscription on day two and a modest 1% grey market premium. The entirely offer-for-sale issue features a Rs 1,585–Rs 1,665 price band. FY26 income rose 23%, while profit increased 15%.

news.headline: From 104 shareholders to nearly 80 lakh! Jio becomes India's most widely owned stock on listing day
news.summary: Jio Platforms has become India’s most widely held listed stock, with 79.6 lakh shareholders following its blockbuster IPO, overtaking Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Reliance Industries and Vodafone Idea. From just 104 shareholders before the issue, Jio attracted over 1.38 crore applications and debuted at a market capitalisation of Rs 12.53 lakh crore.

news.headline: MFs raise stake for 3 straight quarters in 5 mid-cap stocks; shares gain up to 75% YTD
news.summary: Mutual funds steadily increased their holdings in 39 BSE midcap stocks for three consecutive quarters through September 2026. While five stocks gained 15–75% in CY26, several others declined sharply despite continued institutional buying.

news.headline: Info Edge Q2 Results: Net profit plunges 93% YoY to Rs 334 crore, revenue rises 13%; co declares Rs 3/share interim dividend
news.summary: Info Edge reported a sharp year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit due to a large exceptional gain in the previous year, while revenue and operating profit grew. Recruitment, 99acres and matchmaking businesses recorded healthy growth, alongside AI-led expansion.

news.headline: Global Market: Nomura Holdings Q2 profit rises 13% on wealth management growth
news.summary: Nomura Holdings reported a 13% YoY rise in second-quarter net profit to 103.7 billion yen, supported by strong wholesale earnings and steady wealth management growth. Its wholesale income jumped 47% amid robust trading and investment banking activity.

news.headline: Global Market: European shares waver as earnings, rising oil weigh on sentiment
news.summary: European shares edged lower as investors assessed mixed bank earnings and rising oil prices ahead of the European Central Bank’s policy decision. Technology and energy stocks gained, offering some support amid broader market weakness.

news.headline: US Market: Rising Treasury yields put US banks under pressure over bond losses
news.summary: Rising US Treasury yields are deepening unrealised losses in American banks’ bond portfolios, forcing lenders to weigh immediate losses from selling securities against the capital and liquidity pressures of holding them.

news.headline: From Dhirubhai Ambani’s Rs 10 crore IPO to Akash Ambani’s Rs 12.5 lakh crore Jio debut: Reliance’s biggest wealth story
news.summary: Jio Platforms’ Rs 12.5 lakh crore debut marks a new milestone in the Ambani family’s wealth creation journey, tracing Reliance’s evolution from its Rs 10 crore IPO in 1977 to a digital technology giant.
